name: Overdue Package
summary: The Overdue Package is one of the goods Krinkle Goodsteel seeks for his work in Gadgetzan. It is listed in his ledger alongside materials from several distant places.

sections.title: Among the Goods
sections.body: Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan is gathering goods from Searing Gorge and beyond. His ledger names the Overdue Package among them, along with a crystal leg shaft and a balanced flameberge. The package lies in a damaged crate at Beezil's Wreck in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.answer: The Overdue Package is one of the goods named in Krinkle Goodsteel's ledger for his work in Gadgetzan.
The Overdue Package is in a damaged crate at Beezil's Wreck in Dustwallow Marsh.
Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan seeks the Overdue Package along with the other goods in his ledger.
The name marks it as overdue, but no reason for the delay is given.
